method: Manual documentary judgment. Explicit failed audit or invalidated current-source proof takes precedence; then concrete documented catch; then uncertainty; then evidence-backed confirmation. Supersedes metadata alone does not prove ceremony. Catch denotes documented defect, not independently verified implementation impact. No population-rate inference.
rateDefinition: Cell numerator / sampled records in the same stratum. Ordinary-code-review denominator0 => NOT ESTIMABLE. Do not substitute frame counts or rating-row counts.

traceability.method: Each preserved criterion is indexed from the canonical full observation whose MD5 was live-verified at payloadVerification.measuredAt. Remediation refs derive only from the explicit remediation field. Subject/evidence mentions are not silently promoted to remediation. No missing historical revision is backfilled. Completion/test claims and git blobs corroborate a reported chain, not causal impact. Reported code citations remain unverified unless listed in remediationReads.codeEvidence.

remediationReads.completionSummary: The 1h owner-report obligation now lives where a cold-carry goal holder actually reads every wake, not only in the watchdog rail. (1) GOAL contract (packages/operator-core/lib/modes/registry.ts, re-injected by coord:orient every wake): the REPORT clause states the concrete floor (standing 60 min / outcome 4 h), names coord:send to ['human'] as a measured rail, and mandates 'EVERY WAKE, FIRST, before any other work: read modes.ownerReport; if overdue or due-now (last 5 min before the floor) send the four-element report MOVED / COST / OWNER-WALLED / KILLED, then continue' — with the card-4 measurement (1 report, 5h15m silence) as the reason. (2) Orient field: coord:orient now folds modes.ownerReport for a GOAL caller — {lastReportAt, ageMin, floorMin, dueInMin, standing, obligation: overdue|due-now|not-due, instruction} — computed by the NEW readGoalOwnerReportObligation(sql, {workspaceId, ownerId, goalId}) in goal-owner-report-watchdog.ts, which runs the watchdog's own three-rail population query with an owner filter (one query, no second copy) and projects it through the pure describeGoalOwnerReportObligation (same floor + baseline arithmetic as findOverdueReports, so holder verdict and sweep can never disagree). Fail-open (null on read error; absent for non-GOAL callers); started early so it overlaps orient's sequential folds. (3) The rail-wakes-the-holder half already existed (WI-2091959 deps.nudge, once per silence) — verified by reading the module, no change needed. Guards: registry.test.ts asserts the clause text (floor, field name, ordering, four elements, rail); watchdog test covers the verdict (overdue / due-now at the 55-min mark / not-due / outcome floor / baseline handling / sql-mocked reader + null); orient.test.ts source-shape guard asserts the leg starts before composeOrient and is folded into modes.ownerReport.

Keep NOT-MEASURED tool attribution separate. Operational-run recorder stores original serving-runtime receipts and canonical test-run IDs.
